retail_floor.label: Floor only. Excludes listing fees, trade spend, distribution and shelf costs, which are not sourced. Sample cost and sample-to-trial rate are ASSUMPTION.

breakeven.reading: A paid click costs more than one serving's contribution. Recovering the cost of one first purchase needs a click-to-purchase rate of about 320% (impossible). Recovering it over four servings still needs about 80%.

monte_carlo.distribution: triangular (low, mode, high) for CPM, CTR, LPR, repeat; independent

tornado_trial.lever: Click-to-first-purchase rate (offer, price, product page, marketplace listing)
tornado_trial.source: ECDB cart funnel and Phoenix conversion bound the range. PROXY

tornado_repeat.note: Changes cost per repeat customer only. Does not change cost per first purchase.

limits: No respondents, no outside contact. Desk proxy only.
Ad benchmarks are one Thai agency's client data with no stated method; the Meta audience counts are third-party with no stated date for the estimate.

The 2021 survey measures bottled non-alcoholic drinks (sweet group, per the report's text), drinks with sugar substitutes, and alcohol. It does not measure sugar-sweetened drinking as such, and it has no sodium or sparkling-water question.
2024 sex-by-age drinking cells come from a garbled text layer; printed-page image check still needed.
No Thai FMCG channel share was found (Kantar page gave no percentages), so the retail route is a floor only.
Persona fit (the match between the cube and the target) is folded into the click-to-purchase rate; it is not measured.
